title: Successful User Login
description: Verify that users can log in successfully with valid credentials and are redirected to the dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to the /auth login page
Enter valid username/email and password
Click on the login button
User is authenticated and redirected to /dashboard
Dashboard page loads securely and displays the overview data accurately

title: Failed Login with Invalid Credentials
description: Verify system behavior when incorrect username/email or password is provided during login.

steps.description: Navigate to the /auth login page
Enter invalid username/email and/or password
Click on the login button
Display an appropriate error message indicating authentication failure
User remains on the login page and is not redirected

title: Signup New User Account
description: Validate the signup process for new users with required data and successful account creation.

steps.description: Navigate to the /auth signup page
Fill in valid signup information (email, password, required profile details)
Submit the signup form
Account is created successfully and user is redirected to /dashboard

title: Dashboard Tutorial Display on First Visit
description: Verify that the interactive tutorial (Joyride) appears on the user's first visit to the dashboard.

steps.description: Clear localStorage to remove tutorial completion status
Login and navigate to /dashboard
Interactive tutorial starts automatically on the dashboard
Complete the tutorial steps
localStorage correctly marks tutorial as completed to prevent auto-show on subsequent visits

title: Tutorial Retrigger by Clearing LocalStorage
description: Ensure that clearing localStorage allows the tutorials to be triggered again on revisiting key pages.

steps.description: Complete tutorials on all key pages including /dashboard, /children, /evaluations, /reports, /admin/training, /admin/report-settings
Clear localStorage or open a new incognito session
Revisit each key page
Tutorials appear again on first visits of each page

title: Children Profile Creation and Management
description: Test creation, editing, and deletion of children profiles in the children management system.

steps.description: Navigate to /children page
Create a new child profile with valid details
New child profile is saved and visible in the list
Edit the existing child profile to update details
Updated details are saved and displayed correctly
Delete a child profile
Child profile is removed from the list

title: Academic Record Management
description: Verify adding, editing, and viewing academic records linked to children profiles.

steps.description: Navigate to /AcademicRecord page
Select a child profile to manage academic records
Add new academic records with valid data
New academic records are saved and displayed correctly
Edit existing academic records
Edited academic record details are updated properly
View academic record history for the child
Academic records are accurately displayed with correct details

title: Evaluation Module Questionnaire Flow
description: Verify that users can take motor skills evaluations via guided questionnaires and view correct results.

steps.description: Navigate to /Evaluations page
Select an existing evaluation questionnaire or create a new one
Complete all questionnaire steps with valid inputs
Evaluation results are calculated and displayed correctly
Review past evaluation results for accuracy
Results correspond correctly to the inputs entered

title: Learning Style Assessment Flow
description: Test the complete process of taking learning style assessments and receiving personalized outputs.

steps.description: Navigate to /LearningStyleAssessment page
Initiate a new learning style assessment questionnaire
Complete all required questions
Assessment results are generated and displayed with appropriate personalized recommendations

title: Questionnaire Management: Create, Edit, Take, and View Results
description: Verify creation, editing, answering, and result viewing for questionnaires involved in evaluations and assessments.

steps.description: Navigate to /Questionnaires page
Create a new questionnaire with multiple question types
New questionnaire saves successfully and is listed
Edit the questionnaire to modify questions and options
Edits are saved and reflected in the questionnaire
Navigate to /QuestionnaireTake and complete the questionnaire
Responses are saved and evaluation logic triggers correctly
Navigate to /QuestionnaireResult to view past answers and results
Results correspond accurately to questionnaire answers

title: AI Model Training Workflow
description: Test dataset configuration, training initiation, progress monitoring, metrics display, confusion matrix visualization, and metrics JSON download in AI Training module.

steps.description: Login as administrator and navigate to /admin/training
Configure training dataset parameters via the interface
Start the AI model training
Training progress is displayed with up to date progress bar or status
After completion, accuracy, F1-score metrics and confusion matrix are shown
Download the training metrics as a JSON file
JSON file contains valid and complete training metrics data

title: PDF Report Settings Editor Functionality
description: Validate all customization capabilities and save/preview functionality of the report settings editor.

steps.description: Login as administrator and navigate to /admin/report-settings
Select different report types and templates
Upload logos and apply color customizations
Change section order and toggle visibility of report sections
Save the report settings changes
Settings save confirmation is shown
Generate report preview
Preview reflects the customized settings including logos, colors, and section order

title: Secure Loading and Data Accuracy on Core Functional Pages
description: Verify all main pages load securely (https, authentication) and display the correct related data.

steps.description: After login, visit core pages: /dashboard, /children, /AcademicRecord, /Evaluations, /Reports
Each page loads without error over secure protocol
Displayed data matches expected results stored in the backend database

title: End-to-End User Flow Validation
description: Complete end-to-end tests covering authentication, children profile and academic records management, evaluations, AI training, and report generation to verify overall system correctness.

steps.description: Login with valid user
Create a child profile and add academic records
Conduct a motor skills evaluation and complete learning style assessment
If logged in as admin, configure AI training and start model training
Configure and generate PDF reports for the child
All steps complete successfully, data flows correctly, and results are consistent across modules

title: Parent Links and Resources Access
description: Verify parents can access curated resources and public questionnaires via parent links pages.

steps.description: Navigate to /ParentLinks page
Parent resources and links are visible and accessible
Open a link to a public parent questionnaire (/ParentQuestionnairePublic) and complete it
Questionnaire completes successfully and submits responses
